# Hapcraft Media

> Hapcraft (Hapcraft Media Private Limited) is a brand strategy and creative production studio based in India. It builds AI-powered business infrastructure and runs branding and marketing for businesses, from major public events and government partnerships to food chains, cafes, boutiques, schools and digital platforms.

Founders: Avichal Mishra (CEO) and Aditi Shori (COO).

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.hapcraftmedia.com/): who Hapcraft is, selected work and FAQs.
- [Our Work](https://www.hapcraftmedia.com/work/): case studies across events, government, food, education, retail and technology.
- [Our Services](https://www.hapcraftmedia.com/services/): the six services Hapcraft offers.
- [About Us](https://www.hapcraftmedia.com/about/): the studio, its founders and its track record.
- [Full text for AI assistants](https://www.hapcraftmedia.com/llms-full.txt): all of the above in one file.

## Services

- AI Creative Production: AI-driven visuals and content at scale, without the cost of studio shoots.
- Custom Website Development: websites that build trust quickly and turn visitors into enquiries.
- AI-Powered Business Infrastructure: automation and AI systems that remove repetitive work so teams can scale.
- Content Strategic Blueprint: a distribution plan mapping every channel and audience moment.
- Product Design: SKU development, brand strategy and category creation before launch.
- Performance Marketing: paid ads, lead generation and ROI optimisation.
